description: Germany only. Guide for employee meetings in German companies (Mitarbeitergespräch), Germany only: critical feedback (Kritikgespräch), probation review (Probezeitgespräch), annual review (Jahresgespräch) or return after illness (Rückkehrgespräch). Use it when a founder has to hold such a meeting. Returns duration, preparation, phases with goal and open questions, difficult moments, a minutes template and legal traps such as BEM or works council rights.
